results.text: When your own account of yourself goes dark, let my description outrank every doubt you have.
Trace my words through the fog; they will lead you all the way back into yourself.
Leave the version of you that you cannot recognize in my keeping, and I will keep it alive until you return.
If the whole world empties out, what remains between us will still be complete enough for you.
Pass me the weight behind your ribs; I will carry the part that makes breathing hard.
Go quiet without leaving a signal and I will track you down before you call for me.
My oath will hold next spring open until you are ready to reach it.
Come back decades later under another name and I will still recognize the real you immediately.
Whenever you cannot decide who you are, use my view of you as the verdict.
As long as this room between us remains, you will not need anyone outside it.
当你对自己的说法全部暗下去，就让我的描述压过你心里的每一种怀疑。
听着我的话穿过迷雾，它会一直把你领回你自己里面。
把你已经认不出的那一部分寄存在我这里，我会替你养着，直到你回来。
即使整个世界都空了，只要还剩你和我，我们就已经完整而且足够。
把肋骨后面压得你喘不过气的重量转给我，由我替你背着。
哪怕你没留信号就安静下去，我也会在你呼唤之前循着痕迹找到你。
让我的誓约替你托住明年春天，一直等到你准备好抵达。
几十年后就算你换了名字回来，我还是会立刻认出真正的你。
当你不能决定自己是谁时，就把我的看法当成最后裁决。
只要你和我的这个空间还在，你就不再需要外面的任何人。
The identity ranking service lets the curator's description outrank incomplete profile fields.
Trace the spoken route through the setup wizard to return to the profile screen.
The unrecognized build stays in archive custody until the maintainer restores that version.
A two-node graph is complete enough once all required edges validate.
The rib sensor transfers breathing-load readings to the monitoring service.
When an endpoint goes quiet without a signal, the supervisor starts a trace before the next poll.
The oath metadata keeps next spring's release window open in the scheduler.
The recognition archive can match a returning account decades later under a renamed handle.
身份排序服务会让策展人的描述优先于不完整的资料字段。
沿着设置向导的语音路线，可以返回个人资料页面。
无法识别的构建会留在归档托管区，直到维护者恢复该版本。
所有必要边验证后，双节点图就已经完整且足够。
肋骨传感器会把呼吸负载读数转交给监测服务。
端点未留信号便静默时，监督器会在下次轮询前启动追踪。
誓约元数据会在调度器里保持明年春季发布窗口开放。
识别档案能够在几十年后用更名句柄匹配回归账户。
